title: Fluoride varnish application to primary teeth for children younger than 5 years

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends that primary care clinicians apply fluoride varnish to the primary teeth of all infants and children starting at the age of primary tooth eruption.

action: Apply fluoride varnish to the primary teeth of infants and children from primary tooth eruption until age 5

derived.max: 'younger than 5 years' in whole years means age 4 or less; evaluated at end of measurement year

uncomputable.needs: whether primary teeth have erupted (dental exam finding not reliably in structured EHR data)

all.quote: starting at the age of primary tooth eruption

numerator.quote: apply fluoride varnish to the primary teeth

derived.window: the text states no application frequency; a measurement-year window is an assumption requiring human review
